verdict.rationale: Jan's README states it can "Download and run LLMs (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss etc.) from HuggingFace," and its docs describe entering a Hugging Face model ID in the Hub search bar, plus pause/resume for model downloads and local GGUF import. That covers downloading and running open models directly from Hugging Face. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Hugging Face download-and-run flow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face
